message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: illegal profit, collecting opening invoice fees, introducing others to issue false VAT invoices (虚开增值税专用发票) for companies, causing tax loss. Also forged invoices found. So crimes: 虚开增值税专用发票罪 (illegal issuance of special VAT invoices) and 伪造发票罪 (forgery of invoices). In Chinese criminal law, there is a specific offense: “虚开增值税专用发票罪” (crime of illegal issuance of special VAT invoices). Also “伪造、变造发票罪” (forgery of invoices). The examples: earlier similar case: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯". That example gave answer: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯". Another example: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯". So they include both. In this case, they introduced others to issue false invoices, and also forged invoices. So answer likely: "虚开增值税专用发票;伪造发票". Or combine as "虚开增值税专用发票;伪造发票". The pattern: separate by semicolon. So final answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票;伪造发票<eoa>.
